pass_marks.variants: at least 10 forward sessions and 100 trades, total change > 0 and better than live on at least 60% of days
pass_marks.gates: at least 30 blocked trades over 8+ days, forward change if enforced > 0 and it helped on at least 60% of the blocked days
pass_marks.rule: READY only means the mark is met. Nothing goes live without the user's explicit yes.

experiments.name: Wide stop (-25%), no early profit locks
experiments.note: Replay on 268 trades (26 Oct - 9 Nov): +Rs 38k vs -Rs 32k live. First forward day (11 Nov) went against it.

experiments.name: Peak-drop exit: once the option is up 20%, sell when it falls 8% below its highest price
experiments.note: Hindsight (12 Oct - 12 Nov, 476 trades): +Rs 28k, better on only 10 of 21 days. Tracked forward from 13 Nov; the exit price is the one the journal's live shadow rule recorded.

experiments.name: Sector-fade exit: sell when the sector index gives back 0.4% from its best since entry while the stock is below entry
experiments.note: Hindsight (15 Oct - 12 Nov, 437 trades): +Rs 43k, better on 12 of 18 days but -Rs 14k over the last 10. Tracked forward from 13 Nov.
